name: 1.9.9 regression checklist
description: Unconfirmed manual checks retained from the complete 1.9.9 release-candidate line.

items.name: 1.9.9 runtime identity and restart
items.description: Test: Open the dashboard and /api/system, record the ClawMax and OpenClaw versions, restart the container, and reopen the same workspace. Pass: ClawMax reports 1.9.9, OpenClaw reports v2026.6.11, and workspace plus OpenClaw state survive restart.

items.name: Direct, group, and workflow execution
items.description: Test: Send a direct agent message, a group message, and manually run a workflow using configured models. Pass: All three complete with usable output and no unsupported-model, gateway, or stuck-running error.

items.name: Legacy OpenAI model compatibility
items.description: Test: Chat with an existing agent saved as openai/gpt-5 with openai/gpt-4.1-mini backup, then inspect model choices in Edit Agent. Pass: Chat maps to supported openai/gpt-5.4-mini without redeploying, and new choices show supported gpt-5.4 IDs rather than stale aliases.

items.name: Long and incomplete tool-run feedback
items.description: Test: Run one tool request lasting over 15 seconds and, if possible, one incomplete tool turn. Pass: Chat shows elapsed work and the three-minute bound, exits the working state, and warns that tool actions may already have occurred.

items.name: Mobile workflow run dialog
items.description: Test: On iPhone Safari or a 390px viewport, open a workflow with a long run form, scroll it, and submit it; repeat once on desktop. Pass: Form content scrolls independently and Cancel plus Run Workflow remain visible, tappable, and above browser chrome.

items.name: Keys and Secrets navigation
items.description: Test: Visit Agent & Skill Access, Workspace Keys, Global Keys, and Partners, refresh on a non-default tab, and repeat at phone width. Pass: Only the selected section shows, selection restores, filter pills stay inside inventories, and the tab row scrolls without widening the page.

items.name: Gmail browser-vault boundary
items.description: Test: Save a non-production Gmail-shaped value in Workspace Keys and ask an agent without a Gmail skill to use it. Pass: The UI and chat explain that browser-local keys cannot be referenced by name, offer Agent & Skill Access and Find Email Skills, and never imply mailbox access.

items.name: Encrypted secret broker persistence
items.description: Test: With a stable 32+ character CLAWMAX_SECRET_MASTER_KEY, save a unique CLAWMAX_TEST_SECRET sentinel, refresh, restart, then briefly try a missing or different master key. Pass: Only masked inventory persists with the original key and the broker fails closed with the wrong key.

items.name: Explicit secret grant boundaries
items.description: Test: Assign clawmax-secret-test to one agent, grant its declared key, click Test Access, then try an unassigned agent plus a wildcard or undeclared key. Pass: The valid path returns availability and a one-way fingerprint only; every invalid path is rejected without the raw sentinel.

items.name: Secret use across execution paths
items.description: Test: Invoke clawmax-secret-test from direct chat, group chat, and a workflow, then ask the agent to print the secret and repeat with an ungranted agent. Pass: Granted calls report availability/fingerprint, denied calls give setup guidance, and no transcript or history contains the sentinel.

items.name: Secret revocation and skill removal
items.description: Test: Revoke a working grant and retry, then reauthorize, restart, retry, remove the skill assignment, and retry again. Pass: Revocation and skill removal deny the next invocation, while an authorized grant survives restart only while its skill remains assigned.

items.name: Secret export and log safety
items.description: Test: Export the workspace and search the ZIP, dashboard/OpenClaw logs, Markdown, chat, and workflow history for the sentinel. Pass: There are zero matches and the ZIP excludes SYSTEM/.clawmax plus SYSTEM/integrations.secrets.json.

items.name: OpenRouter provider isolation
items.description: Test: With a developer key, run direct chat, group chat, and a workflow locally, then direct chat and workflow in a container; also try an invalid key/model. Pass: Valid runs complete through OpenRouter, failures name OpenRouter, and LM Studio/OpenAI-compatible settings do not capture traffic.

items.name: xAI and Grok provider isolation
items.description: Test: Add an xAI key, refresh models, run direct/group/workflow locally and direct/workflow in a container, then try invalid credentials. Pass: Supported native xai models work, grok-4.5 stays hidden on v2026.6.11, failures name xAI, and other provider credentials cannot capture traffic.
